messages.Sub_entry_ManualFallbackBody:
1. Verifica stato macchina e ricetta attiva.
2. Controlla che VisionPro sia in RUNNING.
3. Osserva immagini camera ed esito ispezione.
4. In caso di scarto leggi Contatori Difetti e Allarmi.
5. Usa Gestione Ricette solo con permessi adeguati.
6. Apri Assistenza quando serve supporto.

messages.Tool_Commissioning_PositionsHint: Configure the positions where the product must turn lights on, trigger the camera, turn lights off, activate reject, or run other events. messages.Tool_Signals_AdditionalBindingsHint: Light blue rows mark signals linked to custom bindings. They are ready for future expansion but do not enter the main runtime automatically.
messages.Tool_Signals_AdditionalRuntimeBindingsHi: Use this section for new real signals that do not belong to the main bindings. The binding is saved in the tool machine file.
messages.Tool_Signals_BackupAndVersioningHint: Save config updates only the active file. Create backup generates a timestamped versioned copy in the backup folder, ready to restore later.
messages.Tool_Signals_DiagnosticHeartbeatHint: Use a dedicated output to verify board writes, bus state, and the commissioning channel.
messages.Tool_Signals_EncoderHint: Set the main axis, encoder parameters, and mm positions used by product tracking for trigger and reject.
messages.Tool_Signals_FilterLegend: Filters apply to both inputs and outputs. Green = active binding. Light blue = additional binding. Yellow = test signal or signal not intended for real wiring.
messages.Tool_Signals_FlowStep1: 1. Fill in or edit the rows in the input and output tables.
messages.Tool_Signals_FlowStep2: 2. If the signal is required by the base machine cycle, assign it in Machine runtime binding.
messages.Tool_Signals_FlowStep3: 3. If the signal is new but its function is not implemented yet, register it in Additional runtime bindings.
messages.Tool_Signals_FlowStep4: 4. Save config to write the active machine file and refresh the tool runtime.
messages.Tool_Signals_MachineInputsHint: Map sensors, enables, and feedbacks here. The channel can be a 1756 DI or a digital input on the 1884, when supported.
messages.Tool_Signals_MachineInputsHintShort: Sensors, enables, and feedbacks - direct editing
messages.Tool_Signals_MachineOutputsHint: Map lighting, camera trigger, reject, alarms, and other actuators here. Runtime logic writes to the channels defined in this table.
messages.Tool_Signals_MachineOutputsHintShort: Actuators, triggers, lighting, and alarms - direct editing
messages.Tool_Signals_PageHint: On this page you configure the real signals used by the standalone tool: input table, output table, machine runtime bindings, encoder setup, and tracking positions.
messages.Tool_Signals_PrimaryMachineFlowHint: Area consigliata per la macchina attuale: una fotocellula prodotto e due uscite trigger camera. Parti da qui prima di toccare binding legacy opzionali.
messages.Tool_Signals_RealSignalsHint: Channels intended for real wiring. If they are not part of runtime binding, they stay ready but not yet used.
messages.Tool_Signals_RealVsTestHint: The active machine file contains both real signals and test signals. The distinction comes from the Real signal flag and the runtime binding.
messages.Tool_Signals_RejectEncoderDiagnosticsHin: Configure reject, main encoder, general alarm, and heartbeat.
messages.Tool_Signals_RuntimeBindingHint: Guided selection of the signals used by machine logic.
messages.Tool_Signals_RuntimeSignalsHint: Used directly by the active logic: photocell, trigger, lighting, reject, and alarm.
messages.Tool_Signals_TemplateHint: The template is only an initial base: runtime does not work on the template, it works on the active file above.
messages.Tool_Signals_TestSignalsHint: Configured in the tool but not marked as real machine signals. Useful for testing, spare channels, or simulation.
messages.Tool_Signals_TimedTriggerBaselineHint: Parametri macchina del futuro scheduler deterministico TOP/SIDE guidato dal fronte reale della fotocellula.
messages.Tool_Signals_TimedTriggerManualToolsHint: Usa questi comandi per validare il flusso timed trigger, le uscite e la ripetibilita dei delay senza alterare il mapping macchina salvato.
messages.Tool_Signals_TriggerAcquisitionHint: Configura il flusso macchina reale usato dal ciclo visione. Per questa macchina normalmente significa una fotocellula prodotto piu due uscite trigger TOP e SIDE.
messages.Tool_Signals_TriggerModeHint: Hybrid uses the external enable; Internal forces internal trigger; External relies only on the external machine trigger.
messages.Tool_Signals_UseEncoderTriggerHint: Attivo: trigger camere e scarto vengono eseguiti sulla quota del main encoder. Disattivo: la fotocellula usa i delay temporizzati configurati.
messages.Tool_Status_BoardConnectionFailedDetails: Real hardware was requested, but the Advantech boards were not attached or are currently busy in another tool. Check DAQNavi Navigator, drivers, power, and board presence.
messages.Tool_Status_BoardsConnectedDetails: The board connection is active. Reads and writes are routed to real hardware.
messages.Tool_Status_ConfigSavedDescription: The on-screen configuration is aligned with the active machine file used by runtime.
messages.Tool_Status_HardwarePreferred: Real hardware preferred. Use this mode when the boards are installed and wired.
messages.Tool_Status_LastSaveNone: Last save: not performed yet in this session
messages.Tool_Status_RealHardwareActiveDescriptio: Commands and readings are routed to the installed Advantech boards.
messages.Tool_Status_SimulationActiveDescription: Outputs, encoder and diagnostics use the internal simulation state.
messages.Tool_Status_SimulationDetails: The app is running on the standalone I/O panel internal simulator.
messages.Tool_Status_SimulationPreferred: Simulation mode preferred for bench tests and first commissioning.
messages.Tool_Status_UnsavedChangesDescription: The page contains local changes that have not yet been written to the active machine file.
messages.Tool_Summary_SelectBackup: Select a backup from the history list to inspect or restore it.
messages.Tool_TestIO_DiagnosticHeartbeatHint: Blinking digital output used to verify board communication and the engineering test channel.
messages.Tool_TestIO_DigitalInputsHint: Live state of the read input channels
messages.Tool_TestIO_PageHint: Read channels, validate heartbeat behavior, and verify digital I/O state from one focused diagnostic workspace.
messages.Tool_TestIO_PhotocellLightingBenchModeEn: Abilita mirror diretto fotocellula -> luce top
messages.Tool_TestIO_PhotocellLightingBenchModeHi: Logica di commissioning dedicata al banco. La fotocellula prodotto comanda direttamente l'uscita luce top configurata per validare sensore + uscita + illuminatore.
messages.Tool_VM_BoardsSummary: Target hardware: PCIE-1756-BE for isolated digital I/O and PCIE-1884-AE for encoder counters and auxiliary digital I/O.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationApplied: Taratura tachimetro applicata su {0}: tachimetro {1:0.00} m/min, HMI {2:0.00} m/min, mm/rev {3:0.###} -> {4:0.###}.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationCurrentSpeedCa: Velocita encoder HMI corrente acquisita: {0:0.00} m/min.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationCurrentSpeedUn: Velocita encoder corrente non disponibile. Avvia il nastro e riprova.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationFactorOutOfRan: Il fattore taratura {0:0.###} e fuori dal range accettato 0.001..1000. Verificare tachimetro e velocita HMI.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationInvalidMmPerRe: La taratura encoder richiede mm/rev attuale maggiore di zero.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationInvalidSpeed: La taratura encoder richiede velocita tachimetro e velocita HMI maggiori di zero.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderCalibrationWaiting: Inserire velocita tachimetro e velocita HMI. mm/rev attuale encoder principale: {0:0.###}.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderGuidanceHardware: If raw count oscillates with no encoder connected, you are seeing noise or electrical disturbance. Filtered speed remains the operating reference.
messages.Tool_VM_EncoderGuidanceSimulation: In simulation, raw data follows the internal conveyor model. On real hardware, use raw counts and raw speed to separate noise from actual motion.
messages.Tool_VM_EventPositionsSummary: Photocell {0:0.0} mm | Lights ON {1} | Trigger {2} | Lights OFF {3} | Reject {4}
messages.Tool_VM_HeartbeatDisabled: Heartbeat disabled. No output will toggle automatically.
messages.Tool_VM_HeartbeatSelectOutput: Select a dedicated diagnostic output for heartbeat blinking.
messages.Tool_VM_IntegrationStatus: Template ready for real signal integration. The view separates machine mapping, raw diagnostics, and encoder tracking.
messages.Tool_VM_InterventionPointsSorted: {0} points sorted by ascending machine position
messages.Tool_VM_InterventionReferenceSummary: Standard reference: PRODUCT_ZERO = encoder position acquired on the active edge of the product photocell. If you change the photocell position from machine zero, the points' absolute machine positions change, not their relative product offsets.
messages.Tool_VM_LightingModeHold: Lighting enabled by trigger and kept on until the configured LIGHTS_OFF point.
messages.Tool_VM_LightingModeTriggerWindow: Lighting managed inside the trigger window. If no dedicated positions exist, the tool uses an ON -> TRIGGER -> OFF cycle.
messages.Tool_VM_MachineEventsGuidance: This page shows only the operational events useful for commissioning and testing: product detected, trigger, positions reached, result, reject, alarm, and mode changes. The full log remains on the Technical Log page.
messages.Tool_VM_NoFusionExport: No fusion snapshot exported in this session
messages.Tool_VM_NoMachineEvents: No machine events recorded in this session
messages.Tool_VM_OptionalBindingsSummary: Area opzionale: usa questi binding solo se la macchina richiede davvero fallback trigger camera legacy, uscite luci separate o consenso trigger esterno.
messages.Tool_VM_PhotocellLightingBenchModeOff: Modalita banco disattiva: la fotocellula segue il flusso standard di tracking/runtime invece di comandare direttamente l'uscita luce.
messages.Tool_VM_PhotocellLightingBenchModeOn: Modalita banco attiva: {0} pilota {1}. Tracking prodotto e punti di intervento vengono bypassati per questo test fotocellula.
messages.Tool_VM_PointSignalMissing: Segnale non trovato nella tabella I/O macchina
messages.Tool_VM_PositionCalculationHint: Configure machine zero and the photocell position to enable position calculation.
messages.Tool_VM_PositionFlowSummary: Fixed machine zero: {0}. The photocell is at {1:0.0} mm machine position. Each event point keeps its own relative product position and generates an absolute machine position equal to photocell + event position.
messages.Tool_VM_ProductStatusDetectedAttached: Product {0}: detected and attached to machine zero
messages.Tool_VM_ProductStatusTrackingStarted: Product {0}: photocell at {1:0.0} mm machine, tracking started
messages.Tool_VM_RejectModeDisabled: Disabled = the NOK product stays tracked and logged, but no physical reject command is issued.
messages.Tool_VM_RejectModeEncoderTracked: EncoderTracked = the product is rejected when it reaches the reject position calculated from photocell + encoder.
messages.Tool_VM_RejectModeImmediate: Immediate = as soon as a product is marked NOK, the reject output is activated immediately without waiting for encoder position.
messages.Tool_VM_RuntimeBindingSummary: Photocell={0} | Trigger={1} | Reject={2} | Alarm={3} | Heartbeat={4} | Additional bindings={5}
messages.Tool_VM_SelectPointMachine: Select a point to see the machine position.
messages.Tool_VM_SelectPointRelative: Select a point to see the relative position.
messages.Tool_VM_SignalAssignmentGuidanceLegacy: Flusso legacy a posizioni attivo: la fotocellula prodotto crea PRODUCT_ZERO e le uscite camera/scarto seguono l'avanzamento encoder o virtual conveyor.
messages.Tool_VM_SignalAssignmentGuidanceTimed: Flusso consigliato per questa macchina: una fotocellula prodotto su DI00, poi due uscite trigger temporizzate TOP e SIDE. Il trigger camera legacy e i binding luci sono opzionali e devono restare secondari.
messages.Tool_VM_SimulationTransportSummaryFromSp: Line speed set to {0:0.00} m/min. Estimated throughput {1:0.0} pcs/min with a product pitch of {2:0.0} mm.
messages.Tool_VM_SimulationTransportSummaryFromTh: Production throughput set to {0:0.0} pcs/min with a product pitch of {1:0.0} mm. Equivalent line speed {2:0.00} m/min.
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerBatchQueued: Batch trigger temporizzato {0} accodato dalla fotocellula {1}.
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerBatchStatus: Batch trigger temporizzato {0} accodato dalla fotocellula {1}.
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerConfigurationSummary: Debounce fotocellula {0} ms | gap riarmo {1} ms | TOP delay {2} ms impulso {3} ms | SIDE delay {4} ms impulso {5} ms
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerMetricsSummary: Accodati {0} | Completati {1} | Cancellati {2} | Errori {3} | Scatti TOP {4} | Scatti SIDE {5}
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerNoOutputs: Trigger temporizzato inattivo: nessuna uscita TOP/SIDE attiva configurata.
messages.Tool_VM_TimedTriggerObservedDelaySummary: TOP ultimo {0} ms media {1} ms | SIDE ultimo {2} ms media {3} ms
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerModeDescription: Standard template: product photocell, lighting, internal or external camera trigger, encoder tracking, reject, and alarm outputs.
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerSchedulingModeTimed: TimedFromPhotocell attivo: il fronte fotocellula avvia uno scheduler deterministico che genera gli impulsi TOP e SIDE dopo i delay configurati. In questa modalita il virtual conveyor viene disattivato automaticamente.
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerSchedulingModeVirtual: VirtualConveyor selezionato: il runtime corrente continua a usare il flusso esistente basato su fotocellula piu avanzamento encoder/virtual conveyor.
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerSourceEncoder: Trigger da encoder reale attivo: la fotocellula crea lo zero prodotto e i punti TOP/SIDE/scarto vengono eseguiti quando il main encoder raggiunge le quote macchina configurate.
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerSourceTimed: Trigger temporizzato attivo: il fronte fotocellula avvia gli impulsi TOP/SIDE dopo i delay in millisecondi configurati. Il tracking encoder non viene usato per i trigger camera.
messages.Tool_VM_TriggerSourceVirtualConveyor: Virtual conveyor attivo: la macchina usa I/O reali ma avanza i punti intervento dalla velocita configurata, senza encoder fisico.
